meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, studies of company finances (DBIE, via the local Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each study is final for its own sample of companies; a later study re-measures the earlier year on a different sample, kept beside it, never chained.
meta.coverage: Public limited companies: balance sheet: equity and liabilities, from the RBI's annual studies (2020-21 to 2024-25 studies)
meta.note: ₹ crore. One series per item per study: each covers only the years of its own study (one sample of companies). Never read a line across studies; the samples differ every year.
